en.title: Seasons in the countryside
en.summary: How the rural year changes, with the language of time and sequence.

paragraphs: In the countryside, the seasons decide the work to be done. This lesson follows the farming year and teaches you the prepositions and sequence words used to describe a year.

Spring is the time when lambs are born, and farmers sow spring crops. In summer the hay is cut and the fields turn gold. The harvest begins in August and goes on into the autumn, when the ploughing starts again. In winter the animals are fed indoors and the machines are repaired. A farmer describes the year to a visitor.

lines.speaker: Farmer
lines.text: In spring the lambs are born, and we are very busy.

lines.speaker: Farmer
lines.text: We cut the hay. The harvest begins in August and goes on until October.

lines.speaker: Visitor
lines.text: What do you do in winter?

lines.speaker: Farmer
lines.text: We feed the animals and repair the machines. It's the quiet season, when we plan the next year.

lines.speaker: Visitor
lines.text: Do you ever take a holiday?

lines.speaker: Farmer
lines.text: Only in January, if the weather is bad.

paragraphs: **1. In plus season, month and part of the day.** Use in for periods of time, on for days and at for points. See Introduction to Grammar: Prepositions and conjunctions.

blocks.html:
FormExample
in springin spring the lambs are born
in Augustthe harvest begins in August
from... untilfrom August until October
duringduring the harvest

paragraphs: **2. Sequence words order the year.** Then, after that, while and when connect events in time. See Introduction to Grammar: Prepositions and conjunctions.

blocks.html:
WordExample
whenIt is the season when the lambs are born.
whileWhile the hay dries, we repair the fences.
afterAfter the harvest, we plough the fields.
beforeBefore the frost comes, we bring the sheep down.

items: Lambing is the spring season for sheep.
Harvest is the gathering of crops in late summer and autumn.
The harvest festival gives thanks for the crops.
Hay is dried grass for feeding animals in winter.

paragraphs: The seasonal cycle shapes the weekly routine of every farm. Many people in the countryside still follow old sayings about the weather, such as Red sky at night, shepherd's delight.
